skill.name: instagram-automation
skill.description: Guide Instagram publishing, carousels, media lookup, comments, insights, and publishing limits through Rube MCP and Composio's Instagram toolkit.
skill.summary: Use Rube MCP to run approved Instagram publishing and insight workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The Ruby shell execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, and code fences. The hardcoded Rube MCP endpoint is a confirmed low network trust boundary, and authenticated Instagram publishing adds medium contextual account risk. No prompt injection text or host reconnaissance behavior was found.

remediation.suggestion: Document the OAuth permissions, the data handled by Rube MCP, and the need to review the Instagram connection before use.
Require explicit user approval before any create or publish step, including the target account, media, and caption.
Warn users that media URLs must be public and may be visible to the third-party service during processing.
Tell users to verify https://rube.app/mcp from official Rube or Composio documentation before adding it as an MCP server.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Instagram connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `instagram`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `INSTAGRAM_CREATE_MEDIA_CONTAINER` - Create a media container with the image/video URL [Required]
3. `INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS` - Check if the media container is ready [Optional]
- `image_url`: Public URL of the image to post
- `video_url`: Public URL of the video to post
1. `INSTAGRAM_CREATE_MEDIA_CONTAINER` - Create individual containers for each media item [Required,
2. `INSTAGRAM_CREATE_CAROUSEL_CONTAINER` - Create the carousel container referencing all media conta
- `children`: Array of media container IDs for the carousel
2. `INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA` - Get details for a specific post [Optional]
3. `INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_INSIGHTS` or `INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS` - Get metrics for a post [Opti
- `media_id`: ID of the specific media post
- `metric`: Metrics to retrieve (e.g., impressions, reach, engagement)
- `period`: Time period for insights (e.g., day, week, lifetime)
- The `period` parameter must match the metric type
1. `INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS` - List comments on a media post [Required]
2. `INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_CHILDREN` - List children of a carousel post [Optional]
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Check limits before bulk posting operations to avoid failures

content.value_statement: Instagram Graph API publishing requires connection checks, media containers, status polling, and quota awareness. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through those steps with Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Searches Rube MCP for current Instagram tool schemas before workflows.
Guides Instagram toolkit connection checks and OAuth completion through Rube MCP.
Creates and publishes single image or video posts through media containers.
Builds carousel posts from multiple media containers.
Retrieves media, comments, carousel children, and Instagram insights.
Checks Instagram content publishing limits before posting.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Instagram toolkit connection.
Requires an Instagram Business or Creator account connected to a Facebook Page.
Requires public HTTPS media URLs for images and videos.
Does not bypass Instagram publishing limits, API limits, or OAuth permissions.

use_cases.title: Publish Approved Campaign Posts
use_cases.description: Plan and publish approved Instagram posts, check limits, and verify status before a campaign goes live.

use_cases.title: Review Post Performance
use_cases.description: Retrieve post and account insights to compare engagement across recent Instagram content.

use_cases.title: Build Instagram Workflows
use_cases.description: Use Rube MCP tool schemas to wire Instagram posting flows into an AI-assisted workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Publish One Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Instagram automation skill. Search Rube tools first, confirm my active connection, then prepare one image post from [public image URL] with caption [caption]. Ask before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Carousel
prompt_templates.prompt: Search current Instagram tools, create containers for these public media URLs, verify readiness, and publish a carousel after I approve the final caption: [URLs and caption].

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Recent Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Instagram automation skill to list my recent media, retrieve insights for [media ID or recent posts], and summarize reach, impressions, and engagement.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Safe Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this planned batch of [number] Instagram posts. Check publishing limits, list required media URLs and IDs, and produce an execution plan with approval points.

output_examples.input: Create one Instagram post from an approved public image URL and caption.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the active Instagram account, creates a media container, checks readiness, and asks for approval before publishing.

output_examples.input: Publish a carousel with three public media URLs.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates child containers, builds the carousel container, checks processing status, and publishes after final confirmation.

output_examples.input: Summarize performance for a recent post.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves the media record and available insight metrics, then summarizes reach, impressions, and engagement in plain language.

best_practices: Confirm the connected Instagram account before publishing any media.
Use public HTTPS media URLs that remain valid through processing.
Check publishing limits and container status before each publish action.
anti_patterns: Publishing without user approval for the final caption and account.
Using private, cookie-protected, or soon-expiring media URLs.
Skipping schema discovery and assuming tool parameters are unchanged.

faq.question: Does this publish to personal Instagram accounts?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that Business or Creator accounts are required.

faq.question: Does it need Rube MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It depends on Rube MCP and an active Instagram toolkit connection.

faq.question: Can it publish carousels?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates child media containers, builds the carousel, checks readiness, and publishes it.

faq.question: Can it retrieve analytics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide account and post insight requests when Instagram exposes the metrics.

faq.question: What media URLs work?
faq.answer: Use publicly accessible HTTPS URLs. Private, authenticated, or restricted URLs can fail.

faq.question: Should users approve posts before publishing?
faq.answer: Yes. Users should approve the account, media, caption, and timing before live publishing.
